description: Agent section-ownership manifest (Workspace Confinement Phase 1, BTCAAAAA-38995). Maps each agent role to the repo path globs it owns. Enforced by scripts/agent_ownership_guard.py as a soft, reversible pre-edit guard. Relaxing an agent's scope is a one-line edit to its 'owns' list. This is complementary to .module_lock_registry.json: the lock registry is a board-approval deny-list for a few critical files; this manifest is a per-agent allow-list for whole sections.
escalation_message: BLOCKED by agent-ownership guard. This write is outside the acting agent's owned sections (see agent_ownership.json). ONE-COMMAND ESCALATION (creates a CTO-assigned child issue and marks your work blocked-by it): python3 scripts/escalate_cross_section.py --issue $PAPERCLIP_TASK_ID --paths <files> [--summary "why"]  (add --dry-run to preview the payloads). The CTO then delegates the child to the owning agent, who implements+tests; the CTO verifies and marks the child done, which auto-releases the blocker on your issue and resumes your work. Full loop: docs/agent-ownership-escalation.md. Reversible unblock options: (1) the CTO adds the glob to this agent's 'owns' list in agent_ownership.json (one-line edit); (2) for a single intentional, justified out-of-scope operation set AGENT_OWNERSHIP_BYPASS=1 and note the reason in the commit/issue.

UIEngineer.note: Owns all web-ui app panels (backtest, dashboard, data-management, market-data, reports, settings, signals, strategy-browser, strategy-builder, validation, ...).

PlatformEngineer.note: API surface plus shared platform/automation tooling (co-owned with AutomationEngineer). Holds the module-lock on scripts/lock_gate.py, .module_lock_registry.json, .github/workflows/lock-gate.yml (approval BTCAAAAA-1479).

DataEngineer.note: UnifiedDataManager. src/data_manager is also board-locked in .module_lock_registry.json (approval BTCAAAAA-1479).

StrategyResearcher.note: Strategy research / signal generation surface (co-owned with BacktestAnalyst). Some files within are board-locked (trade_registry, institutional_signal_evaluator, detectors registry, optimizer_v3/database).

BacktestAnalyst.note: Co-owner with StrategyResearcher of the strategy/backtest surface.

NautilusEngineer.note: Institutional trade management (ITM). src/itm/state/manager.py is board-locked.

AutomationEngineer.note: CI/automation tooling and guardrails (co-owned with PlatformEngineer).

DocWriter.note: Documentation and markdown across the repo.

RepoSteward.note: PR / merge coordination only. No feature-code ownership; may maintain local git hooks. Section changes require CTO escalation, not direct edits.

Architect.note: Cross-cutting design authority (override). Owns strategy_builder/validation lock entries in .module_lock_registry.json.

CTO.note: Coordination / escalation authority (override). Can touch any section; this is the escalation target the guard names.
